form_analysis.feedback: Good lash lift aftercare form with clear maintenance instructions and helpful analogy to hair perming. Includes practical daily care recommendations and realistic expectations about environmental factors that affect longevity. Could be enhanced with more specific timelines, emergency protocols, and detailed product guidance.

form_data.introduction: The following aftercare advice is essential to help reduce the risk of treatment complications, to improve your comfort/healing and to help achieve the best possible results from treatment.

instructions.general_directive: Please follow the aftercare advice for eyelash lift treatment.

sections.title: Mechanical Care
sections.content: Be gentle with your lashes, do not rub or pull at them.

sections.title: Water Exposure Restrictions
sections.content: Do not get your lashes wet for the first 24 hrs.

sections.title: Product Avoidance
sections.content: Do not use harsh products on your eyes/lashes.

sections.title: Environmental Factors
items: Use of Sauna/Steam is possible after 24hrs but may weaken the effect of the lift.
Swimming should be avoided for at least 24hrs. Note that swimming may weaken the effect of the lash lift.

sections.title: Makeup and Additional Treatments
items: Avoid eye make up for the first 24 hours.
No other facial beauty treatments for 24hrs.

sections.title: Follow-up Guidance
sections.content: Your practitioner will advise when further treatment appointments are required. If you are advised to attend a follow up appointment, please do make every effort to attend them. You should do this even if you believe that the recovery process is going well and you cannot see that there are any visible complications.

instructions.treatment_analogy: Remember, the lash lift procedure is similar to a hair perm, and as such the hair must be kept well-nourished and treated delicately to avoid breakage/weakening.

care_recommendations.title: Recommendations
items: Use gentle soap free products around the eyes
Daily use of a lash nourishing serum/conditioner
Be careful washing your eyes and pat the lashes gently to dry.
Be aware that swimming, sauna and steam rooms can weaken the lift quicker.

patient_declaration.reading_confirmation: It is essential that you have read all of the information available. Once you have read and understood all of the below, please sign the declaration at the bottom of this form.
patient_declaration.question_opportunity: Please do let your practitioner know if you have any questions or if you do not understand any of the aftercare instructions provided below.
patient_declaration.declaration_text: I confirm that I have read and understood all the information on this Form and that I have been given the opportunity to ask any questions that have come to mind throughout.
